headline: Approved $21,574 for renovation change orders; also approved September bills and amended minutes.
summary: Monthly reports covered food-safety actions, vaccination clinics, staffing, and renovations expected to finish in early January. The board approved $21,574 for renovation change orders and authorized advertising the chief sanitarian position. The meeting also went into executive session on ReWorld legal matters and personnel matters.
decisions: Approved $21,574 for current renovation change orders.
Approved the bills paid in September 2026, with a clarification that there is no financial consultant beyond Mr. Gillis. Vote: all in favor.
Approved the amended minutes of the September 10, 2026 meeting. Vote: all in favor.
Authorized advertising the chief sanitarian position.

decision_evidence.quote: Motion by Member Donna Friday, seconded by Member Kathy Langlais to approve $21,574 for current change orders. All in Favor. Motion carried.

Motion by Member Donna Friday, seconded by Member Kathy Langlais to approve the bills paid in September 2026 with the clarification that there is no financial consultant beyond Mr. Gillis. All in Favor. Motion carried.
Motion by Member Donna Friday, seconded by Member Kathy Langlais to approve the amended Board of Health Meeting Minutes of September 10, 2026. All in Favor. Motion carried.
